_comment: LEGACY-ONLY seed lane for field-unranked call-ups: as of plan 019 the strongest field-unranked calls (ValuCast rank <= FIELD_UNRANKED_MAX_VALUCAST_RANK, currently 25) auto-mint via _field_unranked_from_row -- their field_label is DERIVED from the at-promotion board coverage, not typed here. These remaining seeds are the WEAKER field-unranked calls that don't clear vc#25 (Kuroda-Grauer #41, Cauley #61, Watson #80), which the auto lane deliberately leaves as hand-seeds. Gabriel Hughes (vc#9) was removed -- he now auto-mints. consensus_rank/divergence null => the card shows the field_label + an AHEAD marker instead of a +N gap; a seed's typed field_label is re-derived truthfully from the archive at build time (_apply_seed_field_labels). Auto-detected rows override on identity -- a seed here that later clears vc#25 will be deduped out by its auto row.
